report:
Reviewed the complete claim, ordinary ty.rs association, both complete harness tests, and the explicit sage_meta::todo::types_aliases_identity test. Independently verified exact byte equality (joining stored lines with newlines) of all three historical implementation/test source files against current files; this supports the historical baseline but is not a replacement for assessment.

The claim requires named, associated and opaque aliases to retain definition identity and generic arguments as semantic types through copy, fold, display, inference, canonical queries/responses and oracle emission, and excludes debug strings as semantic representations. Ty::Alias and AliasTy's three variants store actual TypeAliasSymbol definitions and typed argument slices; associated aliases additionally retain self and trait identity. This is structured semantic data, not a formatted-string surrogate. Captured fold_alias_ty explicitly preserves every definition and variant while folding arguments, self and trait reference. Captured display branches render symbol names and arguments with distinct associated/opaque syntax.

alias_variants_copy_fold_and_display_without_erasing_identity asserts variant distinctions, all three expected display strings, all three variants after cross-stash copy, associated substitution of self/trait/item arguments to Bool, and recursive/universe-leaking named-alias unification errors with the expected variable/ceiling. These assertions detect variant erasure, malformed rendering, missed nested substitutions and overlooked inference traversal; copy assertions are variant-level checks, not exhaustive field equality. aliases_round_trip_through_canonical_query_and_response_stashes checks shared canonical equality operands, named alias arguments converted to canonical parameters, one response binder, named alias response/import, and the imported variable's lowered root universe. This is meaningful named-alias canonical/inference integration evidence, not an exhaustive all-variant matrix.

The TODO explicitly defers completing inference and oracle identity-preservation fixtures. Accept that existing deferral: prerequisites for closing it are end-to-end inference and oracle fixtures retaining semantic alias definitions/arguments, including associated and opaque forms and rejecting formatted-string substitution. Partial named-alias inference checks do not complete it; neither oracle behavior nor full cross-operation coverage is asserted as implemented here. The existing copy/fold/display and canonical examples plus structured source reasoning support the historical scoped assessment without demanding redundant isolated field tests. No concrete contradiction was found, and no production/test changes are requested. TODO remains visibly deferred.

Source inspection and exact baseline comparison only. Personally executed review start and review read commands and submitted this report using review record; no behavior tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported build and 321 sage-meta tests are separate execution evidence and do not establish execution of these harness tests. Additional relied-on fold/display source was captured with review read.
